description: Angular component for tenant profile autocomplete with CRUD and dialog interactions.

classes.name: TenantProfileAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing tenant profile autocomplete with support for default selection, editing, and dialog-based CRUD operations.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filtered tenant profiles observable with value changes.

methods.name: selectDefaultTenantProfileIfNeeded
methods.description: Fetches and sets default tenant profile if configured and not already set.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a TenantProfileId value to the component, fetching profile info if needed.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating validation if dirty.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change if value differs.

methods.name: displayTenantProfileFn
methods.description: Returns display name for a tenant profile.

methods.name: fetchTenantProfiles
methods.description: Fetches tenant profiles matching search text.

methods.name: tenantProfileEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key to create new tenant profile if none selected.

methods.name: createTenantProfile
methods.description: Opens dialog to create a new tenant profile.

methods.name: editTenantProfile
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit current tenant profile.

methods.name: openTenantProfileDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for adding or editing tenant profile, updates model on save.
